text:
Samira Patel: Quick flag — Lighthouse onboarding: noticed 120ms p95 spikes on their dedicated pool when customers send long chain-of-thought prompts (12-18k tokens). Their QoS is fine otherwise. Sharing profiler snapshot.

Ben Cho: saw that. Likely KV cache churn + large batch windows. Do we have their model pinned? Which model + quant profile?

Samira Patel: They're on redwood/clarion-7b@v2, 16-bit. Traffic pattern: lots of short interactive follow-ups after an initial long prompt. No prefix caching enabled.

Nikhil Rao: Recommendation: enable prefix KV caching + aggressive small-window batching for follow-ups. Also propose swapping to clarion-7b-int8-lite — can drop p95 ~30% based on lab. We can canary that behind a routing policy.

Priya Gomez: Can we do a quick canary config? Suggested route: 5% -> clarion-7b-int8-lite in us-west, fallback to clarion-7b if quality/regressions. Also add token-budget limiter to avoid runaway long-context generations.

Samira Patel: I'll book enablement session with customer to explain tradeoffs & ask for 48h eval. Need Solutions Eng to prepare eval prompt set. @Nikhil can you produce sample rollout policy and query set?

Nikhil Rao: Yep. Sample rollout policy:
```
route: {
  match: {customer: "lighthouse"},
  variants: [{model: "clarion-7b-int8-lite", weight: 5}, {model: "clarion-7b@v2", weight:95}],
  region: "us-west"
}
```
Eval list: 12 initial long prompts + 30 follow-ups. I'll drop artifacts in the onboarding folder.

Ben Cho: Also suggest `kv_cache_prefix: true` and `batch.window_ms: 25` for their traffic. Small batch window keeps latency tight.

Samira Patel: thanks. I'll summarise to Lighthouse: planned canary, expected p95 improvement ~30%, tiny quality delta but we'll monitor BLEU/ROUGE-like metrics they care about. Note renewal risk: they asked about latency SLAs in next contract — this improvement helps the sell. Will capture feedback in CRM.

deploy-bot: Canary deployed to us-west: clarion-7b-int8-lite @ 5% for lighthouse (id: canary-2405001234). Monitoring: latency metrics streaming to dashboard.

Priya Gomez: follow-ups: 1) enable KV cache, 2) run eval set, 3) 48h canary, 4) checkpoint quality alerts + rollback at >1.5% accuracy regression. Samira — can you own customer comms?

Samira Patel: yup will own. I'll post meeting invite and update the renewal note. Thanks team :thumbsup:
